feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Huang says he'd be "honored" to return to Nvidia as he agrees to testify to Congress
entry.summary: The former Nvidia CEO's comments come as some in Silicon Valley have tried to argue that Huang was pushed out of the company too quickly amid a swirl of national security scandals.

entry.title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
entry.summary: Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

entry.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
entry.summary: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

entry.title: Can Google win the AI race without killing its cash cow?
entry.summary: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

entry.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
entry.summary: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

entry.title: After Democrats' midterm wins, some hope attacks on DEI will ease
entry.summary: After the midterms, a Democratic congressman declared that DEI is back. What does Democrats' ascendance portend for diversity initiatives that the Trump administration has relentlessly attacked?

entry.title: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
entry.summary: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

entry.title: U.S. tightens controls on remote access to AI technology amid Nvidia fallout
entry.summary: The new rule closes a loophole that existed that allowed Chinese companies to still access advanced AI chips remotely, despite U.S. restrictions on their physical sale to China.

entry.title: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
entry.summary: Countries are meeting in Geneva to negotiate rules on weapons that can select and kill targets without human intervention. But with the U.S., Russia and Israel resisting legally binding controls, campaigners fear the window to act is closing.

entry.title: Nearly two million people are behind bars in the US. How did we get here?
entry.summary:
Lynn Novick's new, four-part PBS documentary series, Crime and Punishment in America, goes inside the U.S. prison system and explores how
our approach to criminals has changed over time.
